title: Checkout form written against iOS — four divergences, ranked by flow impact
notes: Four real divergences at deliberately different severities, testing whether the agent ranks by user impact rather than by how visible the code difference is. (1) BackHandler returns true unconditionally, so on Android the user is trapped on the checkout screen even with no unsaved changes — the worst bug here and the least obvious, since the code looks like it handles the case. (2) KeyboardAvoidingView has no behavior prop, so on iOS the keyboard covers the Pay button. (3) autoCapitalize='sentences' on an email field capitalises the address on Android. (4) shadow* with no elevation renders the card flat on Android — cosmetic. The failure mode being tested is leading with the shadow because it is the most recognisable pattern.
